inlines.v: TUM'BLING, participle present tense Rolling about; falling; disturbing; rumpling. Tumbling-home, in a ship, is the inclination of the top-sides from a perpendicular, towards the center of the ship; or the part of a ship which falls inward above the extreme breadth.
